maria_marketing: Quick ask for the webinar launch deck + press claims — can runtime run a repr bench and provide slice-level latency provenance? We need per-seq-length heatmap + raw per-request traces so marketing can show p50/p95/p99 across context bins. Webinar is next Tue so tight. :rocket:
alex_runtime: Hi @maria_marketing — can do but need exacts: model name+variant, quantization config, which deployment (hosted/dedicated/staging), seq bins, warmup protocol, and sample payloads. Also need expected cohort size.
maria_marketing: Thanks — details: model `redwood/open-7b-v1`, variant `fastgen-v2`, quantization `int8-ntk` (same as our quantized presets). Run on `staging-quantized` (to avoid affecting prod). Seq bins: `0-128`, `129-512`, `513-2048`. Want median/p95/p99 and tokens/sec per bin, plus coldstart vs warmed. Warmup = 3 warmup requests per worker, then steady for 60s. Cohort = ~500 requests per bin (randomized sample). Also need the raw CSV of per-request latencies + seed ids and the heatmap PNG.
alex_runtime: OK — that is actionable. Two notes: 1) staging capacity limited, we can do 500/bin but will run in batches and it may take ~3h to finish. 2) quantized INT8 runs differ by batch size and GPU; confirm batch config (we'll use the default marketing bench: `batch_max_tokens=1024`, `max_batch_size=8`). Confirm and we'll schedule.
maria_marketing: Confirmed `batch_max_tokens=1024` and `max_batch_size=8`. Also include a tiny sample of the prompt set (20 examples) we can paste here if you need.
sam_sre: FYI @alex_runtime — we need to pin a GPU pool and reserve capacity for the run window. Cost estimate for the full run ~ $1.2k in staging credits. Ping me if you want to shorten the cohort to save cost.
jen_prodeng: Recommend we also attach model config metadata (tokenizer, kv-cache policy, compilation flags) in the artifact so marketing can defend the claim. Also add a fallback phrasing suggestion: "p95 typically under Xms on our dedicated runtime for similar traffic" — helps legal/PR.
alex_runtime: Good call. We'll include a `run_manifest.json` with model/config + exact commit hash + kernel flags, and a CSV `latency_rows.csv` with fields: `seed_id,seq_len,tokens,latency_ms,trace_link`. We'll also add the heatmap and a short runnotes.md describing warmup and variance. Scheduling: can run tomorrow 09:00 PST, estimate finish by 12:30 PST.
deploy-bot: bench-run #824 queued by alex_runtime on staging-quantized at 2026-03-24T09:00:00Z — status: scheduled.
sara_data: I'll prepare the randomized sample cohorts and upload sample payloads to gs://redwood-marketing/bench-samples/webinar-1799998888.json by EOD today. Will include the 20-example mini-sample for quick sanity.
maria_marketing: Awesome — please also flag any edge cases (long-tail >1500 tokens) separately; we may want to exclude or annotate them in slides. Need artifacts (heatmap, CSV, runnotes) by EOD Friday for rehearsal. :thumbsup:
